topics.title: Recommended ways to set up the software
topics.shortdesc: HP SmartStream can be set up in a variety of ways, the most common of which are described below.

topics.title: Rename pages
topics.shortdesc: Documents and pages can be renamed in three different ways: manual renaming, batch renaming, and OCR renaming.
topics.body_preview: Renaming overwrites the original files. Therefore, if you want to retain the original files, copy them before renaming. If you rename a single page of a multipage PDF file, the page is extracted from the original document. DWF, HP-GL/2, and TIFF files are not supported for renaming.

topics.body_preview: If you have no scanner connected, you can still use the printer-specific preferences to set up a hot folder from which you can import files conveniently into a job. See .

topics.title: Set preferences
topics.shortdesc: The preferences dialog allows you to configure HP SmartStream.

topics.title: Stamps
topics.shortdesc: In the preparation pane, in the Stamp column, you can choose to assign a stamp to a page or create a new one. This prints a text and/or graphical stamp or watermark over the contents of the page; you can assign the same stamp to all pages of a job, or particular stamps to particular pages.
topics.body_preview: You can specify the position of the stamp and the formatting of a text stamp: its font, size, color, angle, opacity, and offset. You can add various dynamic fields to be displayed as part of the text. TIFF, PNG, and JPEG files can be imported to provide a graphical stamp. You can also import one of these files contained in a ZIP file. If the ZIP file is password-protected, you will need to give the password in order to import the image successfully. A ZIP file within a ZIP file is not supported.

topics.title: Launching HP SmartTracker the first time
topics.shortdesc: The first time you access the application, a popup with the EULA (End User License Agreement) terms is displayed, as shown below:
topics.body_preview: You must accept these terms and click Save in order to use HP SmartTracker. If at any time you want to stop sending personal data, if logged-in as an administrator, you can opt out. To do so, or to review the data collection terms and conditions, click the icon on the main screen and choose Product Improvement . A window opens as shown below: Choose whether you want to participate or not and click the Save button.

topics.title: Logging out
topics.body_preview: To log out of HP SmartTracker, click the icon and choose Log out from the menu. You are successfully logged out of the application. To log in again, you will need to enter your username and password.

topics.title: Marking a job as billable
topics.shortdesc: You can decide, on a job-by-job basis, which particular jobs are billable or non-billable.
topics.body_preview: In the same illustration you can see a setting where, like the setting discussed above, you can choose to provide users with the option to add a comment to a job. To do so, click the icon next to the printer group. In the illustration above you will see the “Allow users to decide if a job is billable” field, it can be enabled or disabled. Your choice for this setting is independent of, and should not be confused with, the decision regarding whether, or not, all jobs for the printer are billable.

topics.shortdesc: In the Permissions tab you can assign permissions to administrators and bookkeepers. At this point there is a minimum requirement to configure at least one administrator.
topics.body_preview: In this screen you can configure two types of HP SmartTracker user: administrator and bookkeeper. Users of the printers will be configured later. It is mandatory to enter an email address in the screen above. Provided that HP SmartTracker’s email server is correctly configured, it is this address that will be used to receive notifications sent by HP SmartTracker. topics.title: Printing, scanning, or copying from the printer’s control panel
topics.shortdesc: In order to be able to print, scan, or copy from the printer’s control panel, you must be authenticated by providing any credentials configured on the HP SmartTracker server for the printer.
topics.body_preview: The authentication process starts whenever you start any of the restricted actions (print from USB, print a job from the job queue, scan, or copy). topics.title: Server address configuration
topics.shortdesc: When setting the HP SmartTracker server address and port number, make sure that you enter the same server address and port number as you used during the installation of HP SmartTracker Server. By default, the port number is 7087.
topics.body_preview: Next, click the Connect button to validate the data. Once you have entered all the necessary data, click the Next button.

topics.title: Creating a group of printers
topics.shortdesc: Ensure that there are printers available.
topics.body_preview: Click the Printers tab in the Preferences panel. Click the Create group button. You will see the following screen: Enter the group name. Click the Create button. Select the printers you want to add, and drag-and-drop them into the group. Click the Next button.

topics.body_preview: Use the icon to remove a particular group of printers. Click the icon. Click the Accept button. You are now returned to the home screen.
